subject.title: [Bug]: Slack thread-session-key ACP binding routing test fails deterministically on main

question: Should this protected Slack ACP routing issue be closed as fixed on current main, or kept open for a fresh maintainer-owned reproduction?
rationale: The issue has a protected `maintainer` label and conflicting reproduction evidence: the original report failed deterministically, while a later comment reports the same focused command passing twice on current main.

options.title: Confirm and close manually
options.body: A maintainer verifies the current-main pass or accepts the existing fresh pass evidence, then closes this issue with the commit/context that made it stop reproducing.

options.title: Keep for fresh failure output
options.body: A maintainer keeps it open and asks for the exact current-main diff or assertion output if the failure still reproduces in another environment.

recommendation.title: Confirm and close manually
recommendation.body: A maintainer verifies the current-main pass or accepts the existing fresh pass evidence, then closes this issue with the commit/context that made it stop reproducing.

likelyOwner.reason: He filed the focused reproduction and is the clearest routing candidate for deciding whether the protected label should remain while this is validated.
